use_case_summary: Primary: searchable contract repository for legal ops - fast, accurate doc search and short-answer RAG assistant.
Workload: periodic bulk ingestion (500-2k docs/month) + frequent query traffic from customer-facing UI (~50 qps peak expected).
Latency/throughput targets: 95th perc <150ms for search queries; embedding write throughput ok as async batch (1000 docs/day).
Model preferences: open/quantized embeddings to control cost; open to Redwood-curated embedding models for quality comparison.
Routing/fallback: prefer single-region (us-east) hosted API; want simple fallback to cheaper model variant when budget high.
Vector DB requirements: Pinecone connector for namespace + metadata support; need fielded filtering on doc metadata and TTL on vectors.
Security: public-cloud deployment on AWS, SOC2 evidence needed, audit logs & retention controls required.
